channel.title: Sample: Business
channel.description: Made-up sample stories for trying out the news reader. None of these companies or events are real.

item.title: Harbour & Finch to hire 300 apprentices across its UK offices
item.description: The fictional bank says the roles, including data and software apprenticeships, need no previous experience.

item.title: High street café chain Brew Lane reports its best quarter yet
item.description: The imaginary chain credits a loyalty app and a new range of cold drinks for a 14% rise in sales.

item.title: Shipping delays ease as ports clear their backlogs
item.description: A made-up industry report says average waiting times at major ports fell for a third month in a row.

item.title: Small businesses turn to four-day weeks to keep staff
item.description: Owners of five fictional companies share what changed, and what didn't, after a year of shorter weeks.

item.title: What a supply shortage actually is, explained simply
item.description: When demand for something grows faster than factories can make it, prices rise and waiting lists appear. Here's how it happens.
